papers.title: ScaleVLA: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models to 552 Billion Parameters
papers.abstract: Frontier Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in robot control, suggesting that broad pretraining provides knowledge valuable for physical action. Yet most Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies still rely on much smaller VLM backbones, leaving this potential largely untapped. We ask whether frontier-scale representations can provide a stronger foundation for robot learning. We introduce ScaleVLA, which connects a 552B DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash backbone to a trainable action DiT, and systematically compare VLMs from 2B to 552B under a shared training setup. We evaluate three fundamental capabilities of robot foundation models. In sample efficiency, just 10 demonstrations outperform a 2B backbone trained with 50 (87.8% vs. 85.6%). In generalization, LIBERO-PRO success reaches 45.1%, compared with at most 31.3% for smaller backbones. In precise manipulation, real-world charger insertion improves from 4/10 to 9/10 successes, with gains concentrated in contact-sensitive alignment. Despite its scale, ScaleVLA achieves 216 ms median latency per action chunk. Our findings suggest that frontier VLMs can serve not only as reasoning agents, but also as powerful representational foundations for efficient and generalizable robot policies.

ai_summary.problem: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略大多依赖较小的VLM主干，尚未充分利用前沿规模VLM的表示能力来提升机器人学习。论文要回答：前沿规模表示能否为机器人策略提供更强基础。
ai_summary.method: 提出ScaleVLA，将552B参数的DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash主干连接到可训练的动作DiT。作者在统一训练设置下系统比较2B到552B参数的VLM主干，并评估样本效率、泛化和精细操作能力。
ai_summary.result: 仅10条示范即可超过2B主干用50条示范的效果（87.8% vs. 85.6%）；LIBERO-PRO成功率45.1%，高于较小主干的至多31.3%；真实充电器插入从4/10提升到9/10，动作块中位延迟216 ms。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将VLA规模扩展到552B参数，并在统一设置下系统验证前沿VLM作为机器人策略表示基础的价值。
ai_summary.relevance: 表明前沿VLM不仅可作为推理智能体，也可作为高效、可泛化机器人策略的强大表示基础，推动具身智能与大规模多模态模型结合。

papers.title: How VLMs Plan What's Next
papers.abstract: When a vision-language model describes an image, it names one object at a time and it rarely repeats itself, yet how the model plans this order is far from obvious. We characterize the mechanism a VLM uses to decide where to look before it looks. The mechanism has four main parts. First, binding heads match the relevant text tokens against the image and resolve them into pointers to the matched image region. Second, the same binding heads bind each written answer to the region it came from, and the model turns it into a progress signal: a cursor, the position in the image up to which the list has been written. Third, a select step chooses the nearest unwritten region after the cursor, or stops. Finally, gaze heads execute the chosen pointer and return a concept of what is drawn there, which language heads and the late MLPs turn into a word in the language of the question. We validate each part of this mechanism through causal patching in Qwen3-VL models on a synthetic visual retrieval task, and test our mechanisms against alternative hypotheses. We further show that the mechanism holds across input formats, natural photographs, and languages, and that its binding, relay, and gaze heads appear at every model size from 2B to 32B. This work allows us to investigate how a VLM turns a question and an image into a sequence of answers, layer by layer and token by token. More broadly, it opens a way to study how models plan over complex multi-step tasks with long rollouts. Our project is available at https://plan.baulab.info/

ai_summary.problem: 视觉语言模型在描述图像时会逐个对象、按顺序作答，但模型如何在看之前规划下一步看哪里、如何避免重复，其内部机制尚不清楚。
ai_summary.method: 作者在 Qwen3-VL 上用合成视觉检索任务和因果 patching 识别出一套四部分机制：binding heads 将文本 token 匹配到图像区域并生成指针；同一批 heads 将已写答案绑定回来源区域并形成“光标”进度信号；select 步骤选择光标后最近的未写区域或停止；gaze heads 执行指针并取回该区域概念，再由语言头和后期 MLP 解码为词。
ai_summary.result: 因果实验验证了该机制各环节，并能区分替代假设；该机制在多种输入格式、自然照片和语言上成立，且 binding、relay、gaze heads 在 2B 到 32B 的各个模型规模中都出现。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出并因果验证了 VLM 在生成逐个答案时如何通过 binding、进度光标、select 和 gaze heads 规划视觉检索顺序的层级化机制。
ai_summary.relevance: 为理解 VLM 如何把问题和图像转化为多步答案序列提供了可解释性框架，并有助于研究长 rollout 复杂多步任务中的模型规划。
ai_summary.org: 东北大学（Northeastern University）

papers.title: BLIP-Live: Balancing Timeliness & Firing Precision in Proactive Streaming Video Agents
papers.abstract: Streaming video understanding is becoming increasingly important for real-world interactive systems. Such systems must be proactive for natural and useful human interaction: they should respond as soon as sufficient evidence becomes available while avoiding premature, redundant, or incorrect responses. We present BLIP-Live, a framework unifying data, metrics, harness, and training around a shared formulation of proactivity as effective causal response decisions balancing the two competing objectives of responding vs silence. First, we construct BLIP-Live-780K dataset containing human annotations of proactive response content and timing, which defines this desired behavior. We then propose PAUC-F, a metric to effectively measure our desired proactive behavior. PAUC-F combines existing response timeliness metrics with firing precision to reward early useful responses without rewarding excessive firing. With our desired behavior defined and measurable, we finally investigate model-agnostic inference harnesses that draw out proactive streaming capabilities of offline vision language models (VLMs), together with training pipelines that learn to further improve their proactive responsiveness. Across both settings, we find that combinations of sliding visual windows, online interaction memory, and structured response outputs consistently yield strongest proactive performance. Our experiments result in two models, with our BLIP-Live-Qwen model achieving state-of-the-art performance across four proactive streaming benchmarks, with gains up to 44% over baselines and outperforming multiple closed API models. Our code and data will be released publicly.

ai_summary.problem: 流式视频理解系统需要具备主动性：在证据充分时及时响应，同时避免过早、冗余或错误触发。论文要解决如何在响应及时性与触发精确性之间取得平衡的问题。
ai_summary.method: 论文构建了包含人类对主动响应内容与时机标注的 BLIP-Live-780K 数据集，提出 PAUC-F 指标，将响应及时性与触发精确性结合来度量主动行为；并研究模型无关的推理框架与训练流程，结合滑动视觉窗口、在线交互记忆和结构化响应输出提升离线 VLM 的主动流式能力。
ai_summary.result: 实验得到 BLIP-Live-Qwen 等模型，在四个主动流式视频基准上达到 SOTA，相对基线最高提升 44%，并优于多个闭源 API 模型。
ai_summary.novelty: 围绕“响应 vs 沉默”的因果响应决策，统一了数据、指标、推理框架和训练流程来定义并优化流式视频主动行为。
ai_summary.relevance: 推动多模态大模型从被动离线理解走向主动流式视频 Agent，对实时交互、具身智能和世界模型中的时机决策具有参考价值。

papers.title: Seen but Unsaid: Locating and Repairing Cross-Image Comparison in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) often fail to match a point or an object across two images, even when the answer can be decoded from their own hidden states. We trace this failure from the visual tokens to the answer letter, in Qwen3-VL (2B-32B), InternVL3.5-8B, and Gemma-3-12B, on synthetic shape matching, same-instance point correspondence (HPatches), and semantic correspondence (SPair-71k), and find two distinct failure points, a small set of attention heads that carries the comparison, and a repair that touches 0.02% of the parameters. Two failure points: exact copies are compared but not read out. An answer-position probe exceeds the calibrated output by 15 to 25 points in every family, for nameable and unnameable shapes alike, and steering along the probe's direction moves no more answers than random directions. Semantic correspondences are present in the visual tokens but never reach the answer. One pathway: redistributing the cross-image attention of 16-32 heads, with its mass preserved, removes 17-22 points of synthetic and 15-32 points of HPatches accuracy, against at most 7 for random or attention-matched heads. A lever that training finds on its own: training only these heads' query and key projections raises SPair-71k accuracy by 28.3 points (Qwen3-VL-8B) and 25.1 points (InternVL3.5-8B), beats both layer-matched and attention-matched heads, and transfers to HPatches and BLINK. An unconstrained all-layer adapter routes 21-51% of its gain through the attention of the same heads, against at most 7% for random heads, and does so by changing what they read (83-86% of the effect) rather than their weights. Every decision rule was frozen before its run, and every reported number is recomputed by independent verification scripts.

ai_summary.problem: 视觉语言模型（VLM）常无法跨两张图像匹配点或物体，即使答案信息已存在于其隐藏状态中；论文旨在定位这一跨图像比较失败的具体环节并进行修复。
ai_summary.method: 在 Qwen3-VL、InternVL3.5-8B 和 Gemma-3-12B 上，从视觉 token 追踪到答案字母，结合合成形状匹配、HPatches 与 SPair-71k 任务，使用探针、激活引导、注意力头扰动/重分配，以及仅训练少量注意力头的 query/key 投影来定位并修复失败点。
ai_summary.result: 发现两个失败点：精确副本可被比较但未被读出，语义对应存在于视觉 token 却无法到达答案；扰动 16-32 个跨图像注意力头可显著降低准确率，而仅训练这些头的 query/key 投影使 SPair-71k 提升 28.3 点（Qwen3-VL-8B）和 25.1 点（InternVL3.5-8B），并可迁移到 HPatches 和 BLINK。
ai_summary.novelty: 识别出一小组承载跨图像比较的注意力头，并证明仅修复其 query/key 或读取内容即可高效修复 VLM 的跨图像匹配失败。
ai_summary.relevance: 为理解多模态模型中的跨图像对应机制提供了可解释证据，并给出极低参数量的修复路径，对多模态推理与具身/空间理解有直接意义。

papers.title: FaceJev: Direct Visual Decisions for Face Forgery Detection
papers.abstract: Face forgery detection methods often perform well on seen manipulations but generalize poorly to unseen ones. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can recognize facial parts and assess their visual plausibility. Existing MLLM-based methods typically express these judgments through textual explanations, but seldom treat individual part decisions as explicit learning targets. We present FaceJev, an MLLM-based method for face forgery detection through direct visual decisions. Following the Jev formulation, FaceJev answers eight independent questions about facial parts using a shared image encoding and reads anomaly probabilities from the native answer logits. A face is classified as forged if any part is predicted to be abnormal, directly linking the detection result to the part decisions. We construct PartForensics, a dataset of approximately 160k images with binary anomaly targets for the eight facial parts, to supervise these decisions. We further propose FS-GRPO, which optimizes each part decision through an exact reward comparison with its alternative, using both detection and part rewards. FaceJev outperforms the strongest baseline by 7.25 percentage points on unseen manipulations. Extensive ablation studies validate our design choices and the effectiveness of the main components.

ai_summary.problem: 人脸伪造检测在已知操纵上表现较好，但对未见过的操纵泛化能力差；现有基于MLLM的方法多以文本解释表达判断，很少将面部部件决策作为显式学习目标。
ai_summary.method: 提出FaceJev，让MLLM通过共享图像编码对八个面部部件分别回答独立问题，并从原生答案logits读取异常概率，任一部件的异常预测即判为人脸伪造；构建约16万图像的PartForensics数据集提供部件级二值异常监督，并提出FS-GRPO利用检测奖励和部件奖励优化每个部件决策。
ai_summary.result: 在未见操纵上，FaceJev比最强基线高7.25个百分点；大量消融实验验证了设计选择及主要组件的有效性。
ai_summary.novelty: 将人脸伪造检测转化为MLLM对面部部件的直接视觉决策，并用部件级监督和精确奖励比较的FS-GRPO显式优化各部件判断。
ai_summary.relevance: 为基于多模态大模型的鲁棒人脸伪造检测提供了部件级可解释决策与强化学习优化思路。

papers.title: Quantifying the added value of human forecaster discussions for tropical cyclone intensity prediction
papers.abstract: The National Hurricane Center routinely releases Tropical Cyclone Discussions that offer insights into its tropical cyclone forecasts. This study examines the added value of these discussions for intensity forecasting beyond a set of numerical predictors. For 637 Atlantic and eastern North Pacific tropical cyclones from the 2002-2023 hurricane seasons, we analyze the discussion text and its combination with 13 hurricane environmental predictors from SHIPS and ERA5 10-meter wind fields, for forecasting intensity changes at lead times of 24 to 120 hours using three modeling methods. In one approach, an end-to-end deep learning framework for the text shows that the discussions alone offer comparable value for 24-hour intensity forecasts to the SHIPS predictors. Adding discussion information to the SHIPS predictors in an ensemble of five such models reduces the mean absolute error of 24-hour maximum sustained wind forecasts for 2022-2023 cyclones from 9.89 to 8.90 kt, with a confidence interval that excludes zero when whole storms are resampled. The ERA5 wind fields have a minor effect on mean absolute error in wind predictions, and model rankings differ across predicted variables, lead times and model types. We provide prediction intervals for these forecasts, whose coverage falls below the 90% target during rapid intensification. Analysis of the text shows that words related to intensity and intensity change (such as intensify, weaken, eyewall and category) are important for the model predictions. This retrospective study shows the added value of the forecasters' discussions and suggests that multi-modal learning can help understand the predictive contribution of expert human judgment. The reanalysis data differ from real-time analyses, and the discussions are issued at least three hours after the valid time of the other inputs, so these results should not be interpreted operationally.

ai_summary.problem: 评估美国国家飓风中心的热带气旋讨论文本，能否在数值预测因子之外为热带气旋强度预测提供额外价值。
ai_summary.method: 对2002-2023年637个大西洋和东太平洋热带气旋，分析讨论文本，并将其与SHIPS的13个环境预测因子及ERA5 10米风场结合，使用三种建模方法预测24-120小时强度变化；其中包括端到端深度学习文本模型和五模型集成。
ai_summary.result: 讨论文本单独在24小时强度预报上的价值与SHIPS预测因子相当；将讨论信息加入SHIPS预测因子集成后，2022-2023年24小时最大持续风速预报的平均绝对误差从9.89节降至8.90节，整体风暴重采样时置信区间不含零；但在快速增强期间，预测区间覆盖率低于90%的目标。
ai_summary.novelty: 量化人类预报员讨论文本对热带气旋强度预测的增量价值，并用多模态学习分析专家人类判断的预测贡献。
ai_summary.relevance: 展示了自然语言文本与数值数据融合的多模态学习在提升预测和理解专家判断价值方面的潜力。

papers.title: Lazy-MOSAIC: Accelerating Skill-Centric Manipulation Planning with Learned Skill-Effect World Models
papers.abstract: Long-horizon manipulation tasks require a robot to perform a sequence of physical interactions with its environment, typically combining several different skills. Planning such behaviors efficiently is challenging: given a library of parameterized skills, solutions lie in a vast hybrid space of skill sequences and their parameters, and evaluating each candidate skill's feasibility and effect with a high-fidelity world model such as a physics simulator is computationally expensive. MOSAIC, a recent skill-centric approach, lets the skills guide a non-sequential search toward the regions of this space where they are likely to succeed; however, it pays the full cost of simulation for every parameterized skill it considers. In this work, we introduce Lazy-MOSAIC, a lazy planning framework that instead searches over hypothesized skill outcomes. A cheap learned skill-effect world model predicts, in a fraction of a millisecond, a skill's feasibility and the world state it produces. Lazy-MOSAIC then uses these predictions to focus expensive simulation on promising candidate skills and, when a hypothesis is invalidated, repairs only the affected part of the search, while ensuring that every skill in a returned plan is validated in simulation. We evaluate Lazy-MOSAIC on cluttered-shelf retrieval tasks of increasing difficulty and demonstrate it on a physical robot, showing that it plans substantially faster than baselines with fewer simulator queries, while matching or exceeding their success rate in every setting. Visit skill-mosaic.github.io.

ai_summary.problem: 长时程机器人操作规划需要在技能序列与参数的巨大混合空间中搜索，而用物理仿真等高保真世界模型评估每个候选技能代价高昂。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出 Lazy-MOSAIC，一种惰性规划框架：先用廉价的学习式技能效果世界模型快速预测技能可行性与结果状态，将昂贵仿真集中到有希望的候选技能上；当假设失效时仅修复受影响搜索区域，并保证返回计划中的每个技能都经仿真验证。
ai_summary.result: 在难度递增的杂乱货架取物任务和真实机器人上，Lazy-MOSAIC 以更少仿真查询显著加快规划，并在所有设置中匹配或超过基线成功率。
ai_summary.novelty: 将技能中心搜索与学习式技能效果世界模型结合，通过惰性验证和局部修复减少昂贵仿真调用。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能中的高效长时程操作规划提供了更实用的仿真节省型技能规划思路。
ai_summary.org: Technion 与 Carnegie Mellon University（根据作者推断）

papers.title: Detection-Efficient Watermarking for Vision--Language Agents via Risk-Constrained Strength Allocation
papers.abstract: Vision--language agents generate descriptions, decisions, and instructions that may be reused by users, downstream agents, and automated workflows, creating a need for provenance mechanisms that support content authenticity and post-deployment auditing without unnecessarily degrading response quality. We present a risk-aware semantic watermarking framework that combines predictive uncertainty with a zero-shot multimodal relevance-risk proxy to allocate watermark strength during decoding. A single risk penalty $λ$ exposes a continuous operating frontier, allowing deployment-time selection of a detection--quality trade-off without model retraining. At a selected operating point, mean watermark strength is reduced by approximately 59.4\% relative to fixed-strength watermarking, while perplexity change falls from 0.3634 to 0.1689 and clean/paraphrased ROC-AUC reaches 0.9552/0.9459. A matched-strength analysis shows that this advantage reflects the allocation policy rather than lower average intervention: at comparable mean strength, risk-constrained allocation achieves substantially higher ROC-AUC than fixed, entropy-only, and criticality-only policies, identifying it as detection-efficient rather than quality-dominant. We further show that threshold calibration on finite samples produces substantial false-positive-rate drift, motivating calibration variance reporting as standard practice for auditable provenance.

ai_summary.problem: 视觉语言Agent生成的描述、决策和指令可能被复用，需要可审计的内容溯源水印，同时尽量避免降低响应质量。
ai_summary.method: 提出风险感知的语义水印框架，将预测不确定性与零样本多模态相关性风险代理结合，在解码时分配水印强度；通过单一风险惩罚λ暴露连续检测-质量权衡前沿，无需重训练即可选择工作点。
ai_summary.result: 选定工作点下，平均水印强度较固定强度方法降低约59.4%，困惑度变化从0.3634降至0.1689，干净/改写ROC-AUC达0.9552/0.9459；匹配强度分析表明优势来自分配策略而非更低平均干预，并揭示有限样本阈值校准会导致显著FPR漂移。
ai_summary.novelty: 将风险约束的自适应水印强度分配用于视觉语言Agent，并证明其检测高效性而非仅质量占优。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态Agent输出提供更可审计、低质量损耗的溯源机制，对部署后审计和内容真实性保障有实际意义。

papers.title: LynnReal-Hand: Unlocking World Interaction with Hand Control
papers.abstract: Interactive video world models enable exploration through text and camera controls, yet direct object interaction requires finer control. Hands provide a natural interface, but translating continuous hand movements into coherent visual responses remains challenging because of complex hand-object dynamics and demanding real-time computation. To address these challenges, we introduce LynnReal-Hand, a hand-controlled video world model that unifies precise interaction modeling with efficient streaming generation. We curate 100K interaction clips spanning diverse real and synthetic environments and develop hand-aware supervision to improve fine-grained hand motions and object interactions. Building on this foundation, we learn a causal flow map for few-step generation and introduce region-aware score distillation that combines complementary video and image priors to refine interaction dynamics and visual appearance. To further reduce inference latency, we propose Ultra-Fast-VAE, a compact video decoder that preserves high reconstruction fidelity with substantially lower computational cost. Extensive evaluations on HandBench demonstrate superior hand-following accuracy and visual quality compared with existing approaches. Our full-sequence model achieves an FVD of 181.67 and a MANO Dice score of 93.02, while the three-step causal model maintains a MANO Dice score of 92.49. For real-time interaction, 540p streaming on a single H200 reaches 18.03 FPS with 741ms latency and an optimized peak GPU memory footprint of only 34.89GB. We will release the datasets, model weights, and the full training and inference code to support research on hand-controlled video world models.

ai_summary.problem: 交互式视频世界模型虽支持文本和相机控制，但难以通过自然手部动作实现精细的物体交互，且连续手部运动到连贯视觉响应的实时生成具有挑战。
ai_summary.method: 论文提出LynnReal-Hand手控视频世界模型：构建10万段交互片段并提供手部感知监督，学习因果流映射实现少步生成，引入区域感知分数蒸馏融合视频与图像先验，并提出轻量视频解码器Ultra-Fast-VAE降低推理开销。
ai_summary.result: 在HandBench上取得更优的手部跟随精度和视觉质量；全序列模型FVD为181.67、MANO Dice为93.02，三步因果模型MANO Dice为92.49；单张H200上540p流式生成达18.03 FPS、741ms延迟、峰值显存34.89GB。

papers.title: Learning What Pairs Miss for Higher-Order Multimodal Alignment
papers.abstract: Contrastive learning beyond two modalities now scores the whole tuple with multilinear products, volumes, and fusion heads, critics that can represent the joint distribution. In practice these critics still behave like bags of pairs. Their negatives break at least two of the three pairs, a single pairwise check rejects them, and when most samples can be solved by pairs the higher-order term receives almost no gradient. To solve this problem, we propose CHORD (Contrastive Higher-Order Residuals with Decoys), which trains a residual against decoys drawn from a calibrated pairwise model, negatives that the pairwise model finds plausible, so that rejecting them often needs all three modalities. Drawing decoys costs one inner-product query over a memory bank, and the optimal residual is the log-ratio between the data and the pairwise model, so the decoy loss also bounds what that model misses. On M3-Mix, where one in ten training samples needs all three modalities, our CHORD improves accuracy on those samples by 21.2 percentage points over the strongest of eight baselines. CHORD also gives the best two-to-one results on every real dataset, and its residual improves other retrievers without retraining.

ai_summary.problem: 高阶多模态对比学习中的评分器实际上仍像“成对集合”，负样本往往只需两两比较就能被排除，导致真正需要三模态联合判断的高阶项几乎得不到梯度。
ai_summary.method: 提出 CHORD，从校准后的成对模型中采样“诱饵”负样本，让这些负样本在成对判断下看似合理、但通常需要三模态联合才能拒绝；通过记忆库内积查询生成诱饵，并训练相对成对模型的对数比率残差。
ai_summary.result: 在 M3-Mix 上，对需要三模态才能判别的样本，CHORD 比八个基线中最强者提升 21.2 个百分点；在所有真实数据集上取得最佳的两对一结果，且其残差可在不重训练的情况下改进其他检索器。
ai_summary.novelty: 用来自校准成对模型的“诱饵”负样本构造高阶残差对比学习，使负样本难以被单对模态检查排除，从而真正驱动高阶多模态对齐。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态表示学习提供了更强的高阶联合建模思路，有助于提升需要多模态协同推理的检索与对齐任务。

papers.title: A2A-UAV: A Multimodal Air-to-Air Dataset for UAV Detection and Identification
papers.abstract: The rapid growth of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) in low-altitude airspace increases the risk of unauthorized intrusions, making reliable detection and identification of non-cooperative UAVs essential for low-altitude airspace safety. However, the existing public UAV datasets are mostly acquired from fixed ground-based viewpoints and are limited to imaging or radio-frequency (RF) observations, which restricts the sensing coverage and deployment flexibility. To address this gap, we present A2A-UAV, a multimodal air-to-air dataset for UAV detection and identification. Specifically, 15 target UAVs of 13 commercial models were recorded at three outdoor sites under daytime and nighttime conditions by using a UAV-mounted platform equipped with an RGB-thermal gimbal camera, a panoramic camera, an RF spectrum analyzer, and a millimeter-wave radar. The dataset contains 105,294 time-aligned samples of RGB, panoramic, thermal, and RF time-frequency images and radar point clouds. Moreover, all 209,539 bounding boxes of the predominantly small UAV targets were manually annotated and cross-checked. Therefore, A2A-UAV provides a valuable resource for air-to-air UAV detection, identification, and multimodal fusion in low-altitude airspace.

ai_summary.problem: 现有公开无人机数据集多来自固定地面视角，且观测模态局限于成像或射频，难以覆盖空对空场景并支持灵活部署下的无人机检测与识别。
ai_summary.method: 构建A2A-UAV多模态空对空数据集：使用无人机搭载RGB-热红外云台相机、全景相机、射频频谱仪和毫米波雷达，在3个室外场景的白天与夜间采集13种商用型号共15架目标无人机，获得105,294个时间对齐的多模态样本，并人工标注与交叉校验209,539个边界框。
ai_summary.result: 该数据集为低空空域中的空对空无人机检测、识别和多模态融合研究提供了大规模、多模态、带标注的数据资源。
ai_summary.novelty: 其创新点在于面向空对空视角构建了同时包含RGB、全景、热红外、射频时频图和毫米波雷达点云的多模态无人机检测识别数据集。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作对多模态感知、低空安防和无人机相关AI应用有支撑价值，但对世界模型、通用Agent等方向的直接意义相对有限。

papers.title: Wildfire-SSR: Geolocation-Aware Multimodal Fusion for Structure-Level Wildfire Risk Assessment
papers.abstract: Structure-level wildfire vulnerability assessment is critical for reducing losses in wildland-urban interface communities, yet existing methods often fail to combine parcel-scale ignition pathways with community-scale geographic coverage. This study introduces Wildfire-SSR (Satellite and Street-view for wildfire Risk), a geolocation-aware multimodal framework that integrates macro-scale satellite context with micro-scale street-view evidence. A Vision-Language Model extracts wildfire-relevant building and site attributes from pre-event street-view panoramas and converts them into structured semantic text. These features are spatially aligned with satellite imagery through a decoupled cross-attention fusion decoder, while a frozen satellite-pretrained DINOv3 encoder captures overhead visual context. Alternative geolocation embedding strategies are evaluated to anchor text-derived features within each satellite patch. The framework is tested on approximately 37,000 structures affected by the 2025 Eaton and Palisades fires in Los Angeles, using wildfire risk labels derived from relative post-event damage patterns to better represent inherent structural vulnerability. Rotary Positional Embedding provides the strongest spatial grounding, achieving a building localization F1 score of 0.6735 and a harmonic mean F1 score of 0.2476 for five-class pixel-level risk classification, outperforming unimodal baselines and an unanchored multimodal configuration. The model also shows a conservative bias in higher-risk classes, reducing severe-risk underestimation, and completes end-to-end assessment of the study area in 37 minutes on a single GPU. Wildfire-SSR reframes cross-view fusion as localized semantic alignment and provides a scalable tool for mitigation prioritization, resilience planning, and insurance-oriented wildfire risk assessment.

ai_summary.problem: 现有野火风险评估方法难以同时结合地块尺度的点火路径信息与社区尺度的地理覆盖范围，缺少结构级（单体建筑）脆弱性的高精度、可扩展评估手段。
ai_summary.method: 提出 Wildfire-SSR 框架：用视觉语言模型从灾前街景全景图中提取建筑与场地属性并转为结构化语义文本；通过解耦交叉注意力融合解码器将文本特征与卫星影像空间对齐，并用冻结的卫星预训练 DINOv3 编码器提供俯视视觉上下文；同时比较多种地理位置嵌入策略，把文本派生特征锚定到对应卫星图块上。
ai_summary.result: 在洛杉矶 2025 年 Eaton 与 Palisades 火灾约 3.7 万栋建筑上测试，Rotary Positional Embedding 空间锚定效果最佳，建筑定位 F1 达 0.6735，五类像素级风险分类调和平均 F1 为 0.2476，优于单模态基线和无锚定多模态配置；模型对高风险类别呈保守偏置、减少严重风险低估，单 GPU 端到端评估全区仅需 37 分钟。
ai_summary.novelty: 将跨视角融合重新定义为“局部化语义对齐”，用地理位置感知的嵌入把街景语义证据精确锚定到卫星图块，实现宏观卫星上下文与微观街景证据的结构级融合。
ai_summary.relevance: 展示了视觉语言模型与遥感影像跨视角多模态融合在灾害风险建模中的可行路径，对多模态空间推理与地理空间 AI 应用具有参考价值。
ai_summary.org: Texas A&M University（德州农工大学）

papers.title: Out of Sight, Into Memory: Compact Visual Latents Retain Local Evidence in Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing
papers.abstract: Question answering over ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing scenes poses a tension for multimodal large language models: global overviews obscure small objects and local attributes, whereas detailed crops consume substantial context. Compressing inspected crops into short sequences of continuous visual latents offers a compact memory once crop tokens are discarded, yet diagnostic studies on natural images find that models often ignore latent content, leaving unclear whether compact latents can retain fine-grained targets lost in downsampled UHR remote sensing scenes. To isolate evidence retention from region selection, we encode high-resolution crops into latent memory tokens for frozen backbones and evaluate both their predictive utility and content dependence. Across two generations of Qwen-VL on LRS-GRO, a 64-token memory achieves 7.6- to 9.9-fold compression of retained crop tokens and improves accuracy by 2.5 to 4.8 percentage points over the downsampled global image alone, recovering most of the high-resolution crop gain with consistent behavior on XLRS-Bench. Substituting memory from another image or another region of the same scene reduces accuracy by 5.8 to 7.4 percentage points and yields lower accuracy than removing memory altogether, demonstrating that predictions depend on the encoded regional evidence. Restoring the source crop within the same model reduces the accuracy loss caused by zeroing or removing memory. These findings establish that compact visual latents retain useful local evidence in UHR remote sensing and identify evidence availability as a key factor governing their contribution.

ai_summary.problem: 超高分辨率遥感场景下的问答任务中，全局降采样图像会丢失小目标和局部细节，而使用高分辨率裁剪图又会占用大量上下文。论文要探究：把裁剪图压缩成紧凑的连续视觉 latent 记忆后，能否真正保留细粒度局部证据，而不是被模型忽略。
ai_summary.method: 在冻结的 Qwen-VL 骨干上，将高分辨率裁剪图编码为少量 latent memory token（如64个），再将其与降采样全局图一同输入，并以丢弃原始裁剪 token 的方式使用；通过替换为其他图像或其他区域的记忆、置零、移除记忆、恢复源裁剪等对照实验，分离“证据保留”与“区域选择”的影响。
ai_summary.result: 64-token 记忆相对保留的裁剪 token 实现 7.6–9.9 倍压缩，比仅用降采样全局图提升 2.5–4.8 个百分点准确率，基本追回高分辨率裁剪带来的增益，并在 XLRS-Bench 上表现一致；替换记忆后准确率下降 5.8–7.4 个百分点，且低于完全移除记忆，说明预测确实依赖所编码的区域证据。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次在超高分辨率遥感场景中系统验证压缩视觉 latent 记忆能够保留局部细粒度证据，并通过记忆替换等因果式诊断证明模型对 latent 内容存在实质依赖。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态大模型在高分辨率视觉输入下的上下文压缩与外部视觉记忆设计提供了可复用的证据可用性视角，对遥感、具身智能等需要细粒度感知的场景有参考价值。

papers.title: [CLS] and [EOS] Tokens are not Enough for CLIP-based Class-Incremental Learning
papers.abstract: Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) aims to empower models to continuously acquire new knowledge while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. With the advent of vision-language models like CLIP, leveraging their cross-modal alignment capabilities to address CIL challenges has emerged as a dominant paradigm. Existing methods leverage CLIP's global representations (i.e., the visual [CLS] token and the textual [EOS] token) for cross-modal alignment. While achieving effective classification, they overlook the rich patch-level visual features and token-level textual semantics inherent in CLIP. For example, the [CLS] token aggregates local information to capture the general concept of "cat", while the patch-level details retain specific localized features essential for recognition, such as the tail, fur, and face. We propose PACE (PAtch-token Cross-modal Enhancement) to uncover the long-neglected local representations within CLIP. First, based on the global representations like [CLS] token and [EOS] token, we identify the top-k most crucial visual patches and textual tokens. Subsequently, to better utilize the extracted key local features, we design a cross-modal fusion module. This module leverages local textual semantics to refine visual representations, while augmenting textual semantics with local visual features. As the fusion module is shared across all tasks, directly fine-tuning it on new tasks would interfere with the knowledge learned from previous tasks, leading to catastrophic forgetting. To alleviate this, we employ a projection-based update strategy to effectively preserve the critical parameter space of previous tasks during the adaptation to new tasks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PACE significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods across multiple CIL benchmarks.

ai_summary.problem: 现有基于 CLIP 的类增量学习（CIL）方法仅利用全局表示（视觉 [CLS] token 与文本 [EOS] token）进行跨模态对齐，忽略了 CLIP 中丰富的 patch 级视觉特征与 token 级文本语义，导致局部判别信息未被充分利用。
ai_summary.method: 提出 PACE（PAtch-token Cross-modal Enhancement）：先基于全局表示筛选出 top-k 最关键的视觉 patch 与文本 token；再设计跨模态融合模块，用局部文本语义精炼视觉表示、同时用局部视觉特征增强文本语义；由于融合模块跨任务共享，采用基于投影的更新策略，在适应新任务时保护旧任务的关键参数空间以缓解灾难性遗忘。
ai_summary.result: 在多个类增量学习基准上，PACE 显著优于现有最先进方法，验证了挖掘 CLIP 局部表示对 CIL 的有效性。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次系统性地挖掘并跨模态融合 CLIP 中被长期忽视的 patch 级视觉与 token 级文本局部表示，并结合投影式参数更新策略实现抗遗忘的增量学习。
ai_summary.relevance: 为视觉-语言模型在持续学习场景下的细粒度知识利用与抗遗忘微调提供了新思路，可推广至多模态大模型的增量适配。
ai_summary.org: 摘要与作者信息中未提供具体机构

papers.title: Portrait Fitness as a Pretext: Probing Implicit Demographic Bias in VLMs
papers.abstract: We audit face-related bias in VLMs using BALPORTRAITS, a new balanced dataset of 9,000 fictional portraits across ethnicity, gender, and age segments. Sixteen VLMs estimate portrait fitness scores for occupations, brands, activities, and banking or insurance products within an advertising-casting framework designed to avoid direct inference of protected attributes. Item-level estimations are aggregated with scenario-specific prestige scores to compare rankings across demographic groups. While the magnitude and direction of these biases vary across scenarios, model families, and demographic dimensions, with age, ethnicity, and gender contributing differently depending on the task, we find demographic dispersion across all evaluated models, with a majority of pairwise segment differences reaching statistical significance. This study introduces a controlled protocol to assess implicit face-related associations and demonstrates that single-scenario or single-attribute audits are insufficient.

ai_summary.problem: 论文旨在审计视觉语言模型（VLMs）中与面部相关的隐式人口统计偏见，尤其是族裔、性别和年龄维度上的偏见，并指出单一场景或单一属性审计的不足。
ai_summary.method: 作者构建了 BALPORTRAITS 数据集，包含 9,000 张在族裔、性别和年龄上平衡的虚构肖像；让 16 个 VLMs 在广告选角框架下为职业、品牌、活动及银行/保险产品估计肖像适配分数，再结合场景特定的声望分数，比较不同人口统计群体的排名。
ai_summary.result: 所有被评估模型都表现出人口统计群体间的分数离散，且多数两两群体差异达到统计显著；偏见的大小和方向随场景、模型家族和人口统计维度变化，年龄、族裔和性别在不同任务中的贡献不同。
ai_summary.novelty: 提出了一种受控的多场景、多属性面部关联审计协议，以“肖像适配度”为间接任务来探测 VLMs 的隐式人口统计偏见。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态模型的公平性评估提供了可复现的数据集与审计框架，并表明单一场景或单一属性审计不足以刻画模型偏见。
ai_summary.org: CEA（法国原子能委员会）

papers.title: Share your Screen and Talk to Gemini: How Young Learners Interact with Multimodal GenAI While Solving Scratch Tasks
papers.abstract: Children using Scratch to learn programming can struggle with text-heavy, lengthy explanations and hints during debugging. Verbal interactions based on screen sharing or camera data may be an interesting alternative for supporting learners. We therefore explore the quality, use, and perceptions of fifth- and sixth-graders' verbal interactions with a GenAI tutor. The goal is to investigate the quality and use of the multimodal GenAI tutor in the given context. First of all, a pilot study of eight tasks conducted without students helped inform the process of the tutor's classroom evaluation. The classroom study was realized after fifth- and sixth-graders had participated in six Scratch classroom lessons. Then 23 students were introduced to the tutor, worked on the eight tasks with the GenAI tutor, and completed a questionnaire. The analysis of the pilot and classroom study shows that the tutor's responses were intelligible and actionable, and no single turn revealed a complete solution. However, the tutor missed existing errors in 61.5% of 603 error-related classroom turns, compared to 15.7% in the pilot study. Children's voice prompts were brief and mostly responded to the tutor. Although a video had explained that responses could be incorrect, 39.1% of the children trusted the tutor's answers to always be correct. These findings have implications for educators and learners using multimodal GenAI tutors, as they need to be aware that an intelligible and human-like voice does not ensure correct support. For developers, our results suggest that screen sharing alone does not ensure responses that match the program state.

ai_summary.problem: 儿童在使用 Scratch 学习编程时，常因调试提示文字过多、篇幅过长而难以理解，论文研究多模态生成式 AI 导师（屏幕共享 + 语音对话）能否为五、六年级学生提供有效支持。
ai_summary.method: 作者先在不含学生的情况下用 8 个任务开展试点研究，再在 23 名五、六年级学生完成六节 Scratch 课程后开展课堂研究：学生通过语音和屏幕共享与 GenAI 导师交互完成 8 个调试任务，并填写问卷；随后分析导师回答的质量、错误检测情况以及学生的使用方式和感知。
ai_summary.result: 导师的语音回应可理解、可操作，且没有哪一轮回答直接给出完整答案；但在课堂研究的 603 个与错误相关的对话轮次中，导师漏掉已有错误的比例达 61.5%（试点研究为 15.7%）。儿童语音提示简短，且 39.1% 的学生尽管看过提醒视频，仍相信导师的回答总是正确的。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次系统评估儿童通过屏幕共享 + 语音与多模态 GenAI 导师进行编程调试交互的质量与风险，揭示了“类人语音”与“屏幕共享”并不保证正确、可用的支持。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态 GenAI 教育智能体在真实课堂中的可靠性、错误检测能力与儿童信任校准问题提供了实证依据，对教育 AI 与多模态 Agent 设计具有警示意义。
ai_summary.org: 未在提供的作者信息中明确列出机构（作者为 Sven Jacobs、Lukas Berning、Natalie Kiesler）

papers.title: AnachroBench: Evaluating Historical Consistency in Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Existing Large Vision-Language Model benchmarks primarily evaluate visual understanding in general everyday scenarios, leaving historical consistency with a specified era and country largely underexplored. To address this gap, we propose AnachroBench, a controlled discriminative benchmark for evaluating historical consistency in visual scenes. It contains 1,600 image pairs from eight countries spanning the late 19th to the early 20th century, each pairing an original historical image with an anachronistic version containing a seamlessly inserted modern object. AnachroBench evaluates three aspects: Inserted Object Perception, which tests whether models detect the inserted modern object; Era-Country Consistency, which assesses whether the scene is consistent with the specified era and country; and Conditional Era-Country Consistency, which measures consistency judgments only when the inserted object is correctly perceived. A false consistency judgment occurs when a model perceives the modern object but still judges the scene as historically consistent. Overall, AnachroBench reveals a gap between inserted object perception and era-country consistency judgments, providing a targeted evaluation of this behavior.

ai_summary.problem: 现有大型视觉语言模型基准主要评估日常场景的视觉理解，较少考察模型对特定时代和国家历史一致性的判断能力。
ai_summary.method: 提出 AnachroBench，一个受控判别式基准，包含来自8个国家、跨越19世纪末至20世纪初的1600对图像，每对由原始历史图像与无缝插入现代物体的时代错乱版本组成，并从插入物体感知、时代-国家一致性、条件时代-国家一致性三方面评估。
ai_summary.result: 基准揭示了模型在插入物体感知与时代-国家一致性判断之间存在明显差距：模型即使感知到现代物体，仍可能错误判断场景在历史上是一致的。
ai_summary.novelty: 通过历史图像与时代错乱图像配对，并引入条件一致性指标，专门且可控地评估视觉语言模型的历史时代-国家一致性。
ai_summary.relevance: 有助于推动视觉语言模型的时间、文化与历史 grounding 评估，并揭示多模态模型在一致性判断和幻觉方面的新问题。

papers.title: Classical structural priors improve neural molecular representations in molecule language models
papers.abstract: Classical molecular similarity is central to chemical information systems, yet molecule-language models trained on paired structure-text data do not necessarily organize molecular embeddings according to graded structural relationships. Here we introduce Structure-Aware Guided Alignment (SAGA), a training-only regularizer that uses Centered Kernel Alignment to align neural molecular representations with fingerprint-based Tanimoto similarity, without adding parameters or requiring fingerprints at inference. In MolCA and Atomas, SAGA improves molecule-text retrieval, shifts non-exact retrieval toward closer structural analogues, and increases average scaffold-split property-prediction performance, while molecular description and text-to-molecule generation are improved or preserved in single-run ablations. These results show that established chemoinformatics priors can make molecule-language representations more chemically faithful while retaining their multimodal utility.

ai_summary.problem: 分子语言模型虽在结构-文本配对数据上训练，但其分子嵌入未必按经典化学结构相似度组织，导致检索和性质预测的化学忠实性不足。
ai_summary.method: 提出 SAGA，一种仅训练时使用的正则化器，用 Centered Kernel Alignment 将神经分子表示与基于指纹的 Tanimoto 相似度对齐；不增加参数，推理时也不需要指纹。
ai_summary.result: 在 MolCA 和 Atomas 上，SAGA 提升了分子-文本检索、使非精确检索更偏向近结构类似物，并提高 scaffold-split 性质预测平均表现，同时保持或改善分子描述与文本到分子生成。
ai_summary.novelty: 将经典化学信息学相似度先验通过 CKA 对齐注入分子语言模型的训练过程，而不改变模型结构或推理流程。
ai_summary.relevance: 表明经典领域先验可提升多模态分子表示的结构忠实性，对 AI 驱动的分子检索、性质预测和生成具有参考价值。
ai_summary.org: 提供信息中未列出机构；Sungroh Yoon 通常隶属首尔国立大学，需核实。

papers.title: RESILAGENT: A Three-Pillar Architecture for Cyber-Physical Resilience in Electrical Power and Energy Systems
papers.abstract: Electrical Power and Energy Systems face hybrid threats that combine cyber intrusions, physical sabotage and climate-driven stress, and routinely outpace today's siloed monitoring stacks. We present RESILAGENT, a concept architecture organised around three operational pillars, Sensing & Data Intelligence, Resilience Analytics & Reporting, and Incident Response & Recovery, mediated by a Cloud-based Orchestrator and exercised through a closed Detect-Simulate-Decide-Sign loop. The framework fuses agentic artificial intelligence and multimodal large language models for cross-modal detection, real-time digital twins for what-if simulation, and a permissioned blockchain anchor for tamper-evident threat intelligence and CER/NIS2-aligned evidence. We instantiate it on two scenarios, a transmission operator under coordinated cyber compromise, sabotage and heatwave, and a distribution operator under a supply-chain compromise during a storm, and report an IEEE-bus micro-benchmark that quantifies each pillar through false-data-injection attack detection, cyber-physical fusion lift, N-1 contingency screening and anchor cost.

ai_summary.problem: 电力与能源系统面临网络入侵、物理破坏和气候压力叠加的混合威胁，现有孤立监控体系难以应对。
ai_summary.method: 提出 RESILAGENT 三支柱概念架构：感知与数据智能、韧性分析与报告、事件响应与恢复，由云端编排器协调，并通过 Detect-Simulate-Decide-Sign 闭环运行；融合智能体 AI 和多模态大模型进行跨模态检测，数字孪生进行 what-if 仿真，许可链锚定防篡改威胁情报与合规证据。
ai_summary.result: 在输电运营商和配电运营商两个场景中实例化，并用 IEEE 母线微基准量化各支柱的虚假数据注入检测、信息物理融合增益、N-1 筛查和锚定成本；摘要未给出具体数值和完整验证结论。
ai_summary.novelty: 将智能体/多模态大模型、数字孪生和许可链整合为面向电力能源系统信息物理韧性的三支柱闭环概念架构。
ai_summary.relevance: 展示了智能体与多模态大模型在关键基础设施韧性中的架构级应用潜力，但更偏领域系统设计而非 AI 核心方法创新。
ai_summary.org: 未明确（作者机构信息缺失）

papers.title: Syllable- and Word-Level Evaluation of Tibetan OCR
papers.abstract: Optical character recognition (OCR) for Tibetan is evaluated predominantly by character error rate (CER). Tibetan marks syllable boundaries but does not mark word boundaries, so a word error rate requires a segmenter. This study evaluates nine recognizer configurations on typeset, woodblock and two handwritten script styles, alone and in combination, and reports syllable- and word-level error rates, to our knowledge the first for Tibetan OCR. The configurations span CTC models, TrOCR encoder-decoders with and without post-training quantization, and a vision-language model, and each is scored under CER, the syllable error rate (SER) and three segmented word error rates (SWER). CER ranks systems largely as the higher-level rates do (Kendall $τ\geq 0.833$), with one pair ordered oppositely. On the effect of joint training, CER and SER record significant changes of opposite sign in 7 of 64 comparisons. SER needs no segmenter and ranks systems as SWER does under two of the three segmenters ($τ\geq 0.889$). The output of each configuration is also tagged for part of speech, annotated for named entities and machine translated, and each result is compared with that obtained on the reference text. As rough guidance, translation chrF of 60 is reached at SER of 0.047 or below and part-of-speech preservation of 0.8 at 0.078 or below, while no error rate separates the systems that reach entity preservation of 0.6 from those that do not.

ai_summary.problem: 藏文OCR目前主要用字符错误率（CER）评估，但藏文标记音节边界而不标记词边界，词级评估需要分词器；该研究要解决藏文OCR缺乏音节级、词级及下游任务影响评估的问题。
ai_summary.method: 在排印、木刻和两种手写体风格及组合数据上评估九种识别器配置（CTC、TrOCR编码器-解码器、量化版本和视觉语言模型），计算CER、音节错误率SER和三种分词词错误率SWER，并将输出进行词性标注、命名实体标注和机器翻译后与参考文本比较。
ai_summary.result: CER与更高级错误率的系统排序大体一致（Kendall τ≥0.833），SER无需分词器且在两种分词器下与SWER排序一致（τ≥0.889）；下游任务达到一定质量对应SER阈值，但实体保留率无法由单一错误率区分。
ai_summary.novelty: 据作者所知，这是首个对藏文OCR进行音节级和词级评估并关联下游词性、命名实体和翻译表现的研究。
ai_summary.relevance: 为无词边界低资源语言的OCR评估提供了从字符到音节、词级及下游任务可靠性的多层级参考。
ai_summary.org: 未提供作者机构信息

key_lab_papers.title: ScaleVLA: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models to 552 Billion Parameters
key_lab_papers.abstract: Frontier Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in robot control, suggesting that broad pretraining provides knowledge valuable for physical action. Yet most Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies still rely on much smaller VLM backbones, leaving this potential largely untapped. We ask whether frontier-scale representations can provide a stronger foundation for robot learning. We introduce ScaleVLA, which connects a 552B DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash backbone to a trainable action DiT, and systematically compare VLMs from 2B to 552B under a shared training setup. We evaluate three fundamental capabilities of robot foundation models. In sample efficiency, just 10 demonstrations outperform a 2B backbone trained with 50 (87.8% vs. 85.6%). In generalization, LIBERO-PRO success reaches 45.1%, compared with at most 31.3% for smaller backbones. In precise manipulation, real-world charger insertion improves from 4/10 to 9/10 successes, with gains concentrated in contact-sensitive alignment. Despite its scale, ScaleVLA achieves 216 ms median latency per action chunk. Our findings suggest that frontier VLMs can serve not only as reasoning agents, but also as powerful representational foundations for efficient and generalizable robot policies.

ai_summary.problem: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略大多依赖较小的VLM主干，尚未充分利用前沿规模VLM的表示能力来提升机器人学习。论文要回答：前沿规模表示能否为机器人策略提供更强基础。
ai_summary.method: 提出ScaleVLA，将552B参数的DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash主干连接到可训练的动作DiT。作者在统一训练设置下系统比较2B到552B参数的VLM主干，并评估样本效率、泛化和精细操作能力。
ai_summary.result: 仅10条示范即可超过2B主干用50条示范的效果（87.8% vs. 85.6%）；LIBERO-PRO成功率45.1%，高于较小主干的至多31.3%；真实充电器插入从4/10提升到9/10，动作块中位延迟216 ms。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将VLA规模扩展到552B参数，并在统一设置下系统验证前沿VLM作为机器人策略表示基础的价值。
ai_summary.relevance: 表明前沿VLM不仅可作为推理智能体，也可作为高效、可泛化机器人策略的强大表示基础，推动具身智能与大规模多模态模型结合。
ai_summary.org: 作者机构未在提供信息中给出

key_lab_papers.title: Share your Screen and Talk to Gemini: How Young Learners Interact with Multimodal GenAI While Solving Scratch Tasks
key_lab_papers.abstract: Children using Scratch to learn programming can struggle with text-heavy, lengthy explanations and hints during debugging. Verbal interactions based on screen sharing or camera data may be an interesting alternative for supporting learners. We therefore explore the quality, use, and perceptions of fifth- and sixth-graders' verbal interactions with a GenAI tutor. The goal is to investigate the quality and use of the multimodal GenAI tutor in the given context. First of all, a pilot study of eight tasks conducted without students helped inform the process of the tutor's classroom evaluation. The classroom study was realized after fifth- and sixth-graders had participated in six Scratch classroom lessons. Then 23 students were introduced to the tutor, worked on the eight tasks with the GenAI tutor, and completed a questionnaire. The analysis of the pilot and classroom study shows that the tutor's responses were intelligible and actionable, and no single turn revealed a complete solution. However, the tutor missed existing errors in 61.5% of 603 error-related classroom turns, compared to 15.7% in the pilot study. Children's voice prompts were brief and mostly responded to the tutor. Although a video had explained that responses could be incorrect, 39.1% of the children trusted the tutor's answers to always be correct. These findings have implications for educators and learners using multimodal GenAI tutors, as they need to be aware that an intelligible and human-like voice does not ensure correct support. For developers, our results suggest that screen sharing alone does not ensure responses that match the program state.

ai_summary.problem: 儿童在使用 Scratch 学习编程时，常因调试提示文字过多、篇幅过长而难以理解，论文研究多模态生成式 AI 导师（屏幕共享 + 语音对话）能否为五、六年级学生提供有效支持。
ai_summary.method: 作者先在不含学生的情况下用 8 个任务开展试点研究，再在 23 名五、六年级学生完成六节 Scratch 课程后开展课堂研究：学生通过语音和屏幕共享与 GenAI 导师交互完成 8 个调试任务，并填写问卷；随后分析导师回答的质量、错误检测情况以及学生的使用方式和感知。
ai_summary.result: 导师的语音回应可理解、可操作，且没有哪一轮回答直接给出完整答案；但在课堂研究的 603 个与错误相关的对话轮次中，导师漏掉已有错误的比例达 61.5%（试点研究为 15.7%）。儿童语音提示简短，且 39.1% 的学生尽管看过提醒视频，仍相信导师的回答总是正确的。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次系统评估儿童通过屏幕共享 + 语音与多模态 GenAI 导师进行编程调试交互的质量与风险，揭示了“类人语音”与“屏幕共享”并不保证正确、可用的支持。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态 GenAI 教育智能体在真实课堂中的可靠性、错误检测能力与儿童信任校准问题提供了实证依据，对教育 AI 与多模态 Agent 设计具有警示意义。
ai_summary.org: 未在提供的作者信息中明确列出机构（作者为 Sven Jacobs、Lukas Berning、Natalie Kiesler）

daily_insight.hot_topics: 今日 20 篇论文中，多模态（VLM）占绝对主导（17 篇），但研究焦点已从“能力提升”转向“机制理解、可控性与可信治理”：多篇论文在注意力头或表示层面做因果诊断，并只做精准修复（跨图比较头定位、patch/token 局部表示、latent 记忆保留证据）。另一条明显支线是“主动式与流式视觉交互”（流式视频主动响应、实时手控世界模型），以及成规模出现的评测与审计基准（历史一致性、人口统计偏见、水印检测效率）。
daily_insight.lab_overlap: 今日只有 DeepSeek 与 Google 两家大厂各 1 篇，仅在“多模态”这个宽泛标签上重合，但实质方向并不相同：DeepSeek 的 ScaleVLA 是模型规模化路线，把 VLA 推到 552B 参数，并用统一设置验证前沿 VLM 可作为机器人策略的基础；Google 的 Gemini 论文是 HCI/教育场景下的用户研究，评估儿童通过屏幕共享和语音与多模态 GenAI 编程调试的交互质量与风险。两者既不构成方法竞争，也不形成直接互补：一个在扩大具身智能的模型规模，一个在检验多模态助手的真实使用效果。
daily_insight.signals: 1) DeepSeek 首次进入 VLA/具身智能，并直接推到 552B 参数，这暗示“大模型厂商用 VLM 基础扩规模来做机器人策略”可能是下一轮竞争焦点；2) VLM 研究出现“机制定位后精准修复”的范式转变，从重新训练转向只修改少量注意力头或替换少量 latent，使成本明显降低；3) 世界模型方向出现两份关于实时流式生成的工作（手部精细交互、技能效果模型加速规划），强调可交互性和实时性，而不只是视频生成质量；4) 安全与评测类论文明显增多（水印、偏见审计、历史一致性基准），表明监管与可信评估需求正在向 VLM 层渗透。
daily_insight.overlap_topic: 无实质重合（仅“多模态”标签层面交集，DeepSeek 为具身 VLA 规模化，Google 为多模态 GenAI 教育交互评估）
